annotations.title: ADVANCED: Execute an existing ATL decision

description: ADVANCED DECISION-BOUND EXECUTION TOOL. Execute a previously returned ATL Decision using the exact decision_reference and outcome_correlation_token from atl_decide/next_step; do not invent or alter them and do not choose a provider here. ATL validates the Decision, executes the selected provider/tool, may apply bounded fallback, and records the execution Outcome automatically. Use atl_complete_task for normal task-in/result-out work. Unlike atl_outcome, atl_execute performs the provider/tool execution; atl_outcome only records externally observed results.

decision_reference.description: Exact Decision reference returned by ATL. Copy it from atl_decide or next_step; never invent or modify it.

input.description: The task input to execute with the provider/tool selected by the referenced ATL Decision.

outcome_correlation_token.description: Exact Outcome correlation token returned with the ATL Decision. Copy it unchanged; never invent or modify it.

tenant_scope.description: Optional tenant scope for the execution authorization.

name: atl_execute
